probe.ask: Reply with only the exact text of my previous message, nothing else.

notes: Measured 2026-11-15 on DeepAI Code pi sessions. Store: one JSONL per session at ~/.deepai-code/userdata/deepai/pi/deepai/sessions/--<cwd with / as ->--/<ts>_<session id>.jsonl, where <ts> is the session timestamp with ':' and '.' as '-' (e.g. 2026-11-06T12-05-46-865Z_01a1b0c0-2cf0-7746-a017-eb84d2179580.jsonl). Line 1 is {type:session, version:3, id:<uuid7>, timestamp:ISO ms Z, cwd}. Real sessions follow with model_change / thinking_level_change records (omitted here: the IR model belongs to the source provider). Messages are {type:message, id:<8 hex>, parentId:<previous record id or null>, timestamp:ISO, message:{role, content:[{type:text,text}], timestamp:<ms int>}}; assistant messages also carry api, provider, model, usage, stopReason. Real tool calls are content items {type:toolCall} with separate role toolResult records; transplants render actions as text instead. pi resumes with --session <path|id> -p <text>. The data dir moves (app running: ~/.deepai-code/userdata/...; app closed: pi-deep uses ~/.subway-context/pi), so resume opens the written file by path (resume.ref=path), which pi accepts in either case.
